# Daniel Manzela

> Founding AI Product Builder. Co-founder CEO/CPO at TNG Shopper (top-100 retail-tech 2025). 9 years full-stack engineering + 6 years production AI. 5 zero-to-one AI products shipped. Open to relocation.

## Live work

- [TNG Pipeline Observatory](https://manzela.github.io/pipeline-observatory/): operational metrics for the production 7-node multi-agent system running for 11 enterprise customers across 5 countries.
- [TNG DAG schematic (anchor)](https://manzela.github.io/pipeline-observatory/#dag): the 7-node DAG, MoE routing, LoRA adapters, deterministic O-R-A-V (Observe / Reason / Act / Validate) gating.
- [TNG Case Studies](https://manzela.github.io/pipeline-observatory/case-studies.html): per-client outcomes, indexed pages, impressions.
- [TNG Front-end demo](https://youtu.be/czZsPbylC1M): sole-engineer build in less than a month from ideation to production.

## Portfolio

- [Profile](https://manzela.github.io/Manzela/): career arc, work overview.
- [Seller App](https://manzela.github.io/Manzela/seller-app/): 4-year bootstrap. 60M+ canonical SKUs, $10K MRR.
- [Tasko AI](https://manzela.github.io/Manzela/tasko-ai/): production agentic system before the term existed. 21M+ messages trained.
- [Data Mining](https://manzela.github.io/Manzela/data-mining/): 5-stage scraping pipeline. ₪50M+ AUM.
- [Junior Years](https://manzela.github.io/Manzela/junior-years/): solo contractor, 3 startups + 2 low-techs.
- [Elysium](https://manzela.github.io/Manzela/elysium/): physical-context AI for retail. 11 specialized agents, 15 patent claims.

## Open-source

- [Antigravity-OS](https://github.com/Manzela/Antigravity-OS) (PyPI: ag-os): open-source governance kernel for AI agents. 9-rule Constitution, MCP server, Dreaming Module.
- [agent-dag-pipeline](https://github.com/Manzela/agent-dag-pipeline): reference 7-node multi-agent DAG with Google ADK + Vertex AI.
- [gemma4-vllm-deployment](https://github.com/Manzela/gemma4-vllm-deployment): forensic runbook of 20 production-MoE failure modes.
- [WP-Multisite](https://github.com/Manzela/WP-Multisite): sanitized blueprint of the TNG WordPress multisite SEO/AEO infrastructure.
- [Atelier](https://github.com/Manzela/Atelier): autonomous design agent for Google AI Agents Challenge 2026 (submission 2026-06-03).
